name: @stackline/resolve-url-loader
description: Compatibility-first webpack Sass URL rebasing loader with maintained packaging and first-party types

scripts.lint: eslint index.js index.mjs lib scripts test eslint.config.mjs
scripts.test:types: node node_modules/typescript-3-9/bin/tsc -p test/types/tsconfig.legacy.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p test/types/tsconfig.modern.json
scripts.test: npm run test:upstream && npm run test:differential && npm run test:contract && npm run test:webpack && npm run test:esm && npm run test:types
scripts.test:coverage: c8 --all --include='index.js' --include='lib/**/*.js' --exclude='lib/vendor/**' --check-coverage --lines 85 --functions 85 --branches 75 node --test test/upstream.test.cjs test/differential.test.cjs test/contract.test.cjs test/malformed-security.test.cjs test/stress.test.cjs test/windows-path.test.cjs
scripts.verify: npm run clean && npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:smoke && npm run check:package && npm run pack:check && npm run check:licenses && npm run check:release && npm run check:vendor && npm run audit:dependencies && npm run audit:all && npm run audit:signatures
